EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Source reported on own initiative that a source with access to harbour control reports interference is scheduled rather than continuous.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Torvik Harbour Authority, 19th Signals Regiment.

3. Source noted that instructions were passed verbally rather than through the usual written schedule, which source considered unusual.

4. Source placed the activity between 0403Z and 1712Z, and was able to observe for approximately 20 minutes before withdrawing.

5. Source was not able to establish the destination of the activity, nor whether it was directed or routine.
